note: Made by Obay's second method (see "method"): the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning, 10 picture ideas are written for each ("sections"), the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye. Each scene is made wide (1920x1088) and tall (1088x1920) from the same description and starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. Pictures already used in the chapters beside this one are not repeated, and the important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: This is real. We saw, heard and touched the life that came from the Father, and we tell you so that you can share it with us and our joy can be full.
ideas: An old man tells his grandchildren what he once saw, his hands open as if he still holds it
A young woman bursts in, coat still on, telling her family what she has just seen
A friend pulls a friend by the hand: come and see
A hand reaches out and touches sunlight on a wall
A seedling breaks through dry, cracked ground
A newborn is placed in a grandmother's arms for the first time
A flame is passed from one candle to another among glad faces
At a full, glad table a chair is pulled out for a newcomer
Friends pull a shy newcomer into the middle of their group photograph
Neighbours are waved over the fence to join a meal in the garden

sections.meaning: God is light, with no darkness in him at all. To walk with him is to live in the light, where we have each other and are made clean.
ideas: Above the clouds at sunrise, light from edge to edge
A small girl in a meadow lifts her face to the morning sun, everything flooded with light
A family throws open the shutters and light fills the whole house
A hiker stands on a summit above the clouds at sunrise
A man in the dark holds a smiling mask over his face
A man steps out of a dark doorway into a sunlit street where friends wait for him
Friends walk together down an open road in full morning light
A man slips out of a back door at night with his hood up
A room so full of midday light that nothing in it casts a shadow
Children run out of a dark tunnel into the bright day

sections.meaning: Do not pretend you have no sin. Own up to it, and God, who keeps his word, forgives you and washes you clean.
ideas: A small boy with chocolate all over his face shakes his head: it was not me
A man at a mirror covers his own eyes
A man shows one clean hand and hides a dirty one behind his back
A boy owns up with the broken vase in his hands, and his mother kneels and holds him
A father washes thick mud off his small son's hands at the garden tap
Muddy hands held open under clean running water
A teenager hands over the keys of the dented car, and his father's hand rests on his shoulder
A stained white shirt comes out clean and is held up to the light
A woman wipes a fogged mirror clear
A boy sweeps the broken pieces under the rug

scenes.principle: This is real and first-hand: what we heard, saw and touched, we now tell you.
scenes.shows: An old man tells his grandchildren what he once saw, his hands open as if he still holds it.
scenes.prompt: An old man sits at a kitchen table, leaning forward, telling his two grandchildren about something wonderful he once saw with his own eyes. His eyes are bright and alive, and his weathered hands are held open and cupped in front of him as if he can still feel what he once held. The children, about seven and nine, lean in close, wide-eyed, hanging on every word. Soft clear daylight from a window.

scenes.principle: We tell you so that you can share it with us, and our joy can be full.
scenes.shows: Friends pull a shy newcomer into the middle of their group photograph.
scenes.prompt: A group of friends of different ages stand close together for a group photograph in a sunny garden, laughing, arms around one another's shoulders. Two of them reach out and pull a shy newcomer by the arm into the very middle of the group, and he is breaking into a surprised, happy smile. Full bright afternoon daylight.

scenes.principle: God is light, and in him there is no darkness at all.
scenes.shows: A small girl in a meadow lifts her face to the morning sun, everything flooded with light.
scenes.prompt: A small girl of about six stands in a wide open meadow in the full clear light of morning with her eyes closed and her face lifted to the sun, her arms a little out from her sides, smiling, completely bathed in bright golden-white light. The whole landscape around her is flooded with light: there is no dark corner and no deep shadow anywhere in the picture.

scenes.principle: To walk with him is to leave the dark and live in the light, where we have each other.
scenes.shows: A man steps out of a dark doorway into a sunlit street where friends wait for him.
scenes.prompt: A man steps out of a dark, shadowed doorway into a bright sunlit street where three friends wait for him with open, glad faces, one of them holding out a hand to him. His back foot is still in the darkness, and his face and shoulders are already in the sunlight; he is beginning to smile. Clear late-morning light, with a strong contrast between the dark doorway and the bright street.

scenes.principle: Saying we have no sin fools only ourselves.
scenes.shows: A small boy with chocolate all over his face shakes his head: it was not me.
scenes.prompt: A small boy of about four stands at a kitchen table beside a chocolate cake with a big piece plainly missing. His mouth, cheeks and fingers are smeared with chocolate, and he looks straight up at someone out of frame with wide innocent eyes, shaking his head, both sticky hands spread as if to say it was not him. Bright, even kitchen daylight. No adult is in the picture.

scenes.principle: Own up to it, and he forgives us and washes us clean.
scenes.shows: A father washes thick mud off his small son's hands at the garden tap.
scenes.prompt: In a back garden a father crouches at an outdoor tap, gently washing thick mud off the hands of his small son, about five, whose clothes and knees are muddy too. Clean water runs over the small hands and the mud streams away; the boy looks up at his father, relieved and trusting, and the father smiles. The father is seen from the side and a little from behind. Bright overcast daylight.
